description:
Down-on-his-luck Koushi Nagumo wanders the streets unemployed, homeless, and in search of his next meal. His fortunes improve after a chance meeting with a vivacious young woman whose proposition seemingly solves nearly all his problems. Thanks to her, Koushi enters the welcoming halls of a dormitory at a women’s college… only this particular assignment is no stuffy, sleepy affair. The Goddess’ Dormitory is known for housing the college’s most unruly students! If he wants to keep a roof over his head, Koushi must become the “Dormitory Mother” charged with maintaining order and good discipline. But doing his job and keeping his sanity are no small feat with characters as endearingly eccentric and untamable as these!

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

node.description: Atena grew up sheltered from boys. As a result, she can't handle being near them and will get a severe nosebleed if she touches one.

Serene is mysterious, easy-going and docile. She usually doesn't leave the dorm other than for school, but with Koushi's help, she managed to go out on a trip with everyone. Her room is filled with trash that she claims can suck the moon energy needed to help her with her lunar technology.

As a fashion aficionado, Frey loves to make dresses and is an avid cosplayer. She is bashful and happy. Though, she can be strong headed and stubborn at times (as shown in her making people wear an outfit no matter what).

Kiriya was raised in a martial arts dojo alongside her three brothers. She bought a shoujo manga for the first time in college and was instantly hooked. But she often gets too excited reading these love stories. This leads to her breaking walls with her martial arts. She also has the habit of tossing and turning a lot in her sleep. Because of her stoic personality at school, she secretly feels pressured to set a good example around the other students. ~!After Koushi started treating her like a girl and not a tomboy, she begins to grow feelings towards him. This leads her to acting more embarrassed and girly in his presence.!~

Mineru is a fourth year student who lives in the Seikan's "Goddess Dormitory."

Mineru is a researcher who loves working with toxic gas, but due to that she often fails her experiments.

Sutea is a childhood friend of Koshi Nagumo.

She has a crush on Koushi and easily gets worried about him, but acts like she isn't. She has a heat sensitive body and dislikes being touched. ~!When she revealed that to young Koushi, he ended up cooling his hands with ice before touching her.!~

Koshi is quite responsible and mature for his age. Even after being abandoned by his father, he fell into depression and tried to look for a job. When he started to work as dorm mother, even though the girls were older than him, he didn't hesitate to scold them. He even tries to warn them to be more aware of how they act and dress as he is still a boy and has desires.

On his birthday, Koshi's house burns down, and having no money, his father decides to abandon and leave. Roaming the streets, he falls exhausted from hunger. [Mineru Wachi](https://anilist.co/character/205448/Mineru-Wachi) finds him and takes him to her dorm, where she gives him food. There he meets the other members in the dorm. Learning about Koshi's situation, Mineru proposes he lives there and works as dorm mother. Only [Atena Saotome](https://anilist.co/character/205447/Atena-Saotome) is against it as she can't handle being close to men. Koshi decides to turn the offer down as he doesn't want to make Atena not feel at ease at her home. Seeing how considerate he is, Atena decides to accept him and allows him to be the dorm mother.

Koshi then starts doing daily chores, but while doing so, he often runs into the troubling members. Mineru often works with poisonous experiments and walks naked. [Frey](https://anilist.co/character/205452/Frey) likes to cosplay and forces Koshi to be her model. [Kiriya Sensho](https://anilist.co/character/205450/Kiriya-Senshou) is a martial artist who gets excited while reading shoujo manga and relieves stress by punching the walls. And [Serene Hozumi](https://anilist.co/character/205449/Serene-Hozumi) who uses him as a servant.
